data.content_ref: inline:The target proposes a 'shares mechanism' relation but fails to specify a shared mechanism; it only states a thematic overlap (black-swan anomaly detection) and a candidate underlying cause (compressed experience). The problem asks for a substantive relation naming its KIND and stating what it is REFUTED IF — the kind is named, but the mechanism itself is merely asserted, not connected to 0ed98c9fe96a's actual content. There is no reduction, dependence, or integration shown between the two nodes' internals; the relation is a label pasted on a summary of two endpoints. A genuine shared-mechanism claim would need to tie a specific mechanism in 0ed98c9fe96a to a corresponding one in SRC_002, not just assert both touch black swans and one invokes compressed experience.
